Chapter 211: Chapter 11 The Tremor of the Chikun Star Domain (Please Subscribe)

“Refuse me?”

“Why would he refuse me…”

Lin Yuan pondered for a moment and roughly speculated the reason.

The Evolvers he had selected, without exception, were either extremely famous, had a profound background, or possessed talent that was unmatched in a Star Domain.

Such Evolvers were essentially ‘celebrity’ Evolvers.

Who knows how many people were paying attention to them.

...

If they accepted just any Evolver’s challenge, they might as well stop cultivating and just keep accepting challenges from start to finish.

Moreover,

casually accepting challenges from unknown Evolvers

Winning was taken for granted.

But if by some chance they lost, it would be very embarrassing.

Therefore,

unless it was an Evolver of the same level and status,

those ‘celebrity’ Evolvers would not easily accept challenges.

“If that’s the case…”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts surged, “then I will apply for a challenge with my true identity.”

The so-called true identity obviously was not the ‘Lin Yuan’ persona.

But rather the identity of the Peak Master of the thirteenth peak of the Red Kun Lineage.

In terms of the level of attention, the mysterious Peak Master of the thirteenth peak of the Red Kun Lineage.

It was estimated that there was not an Evolver who would not be curious.

And with the high status of the Peak Master of the thirteenth peak, there were probably not many Evolvers who would refuse a challenge issued by him.

Even if they lost, there was a reason for it. After all, it was the Peak Master of the thirteenth peak; isn’t it normal if I lost?

If they could win, then they would have beaten the Peak Master of the thirteenth peak.

With that thought, Lin Yuan immediately switched identities.

…

The Virtual World of the Red Kun Lineage.

The thirteenth main peak.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared in the grand hall at the peak’s summit.

Since he had yet to step into the Sixth Rank, Lin Yuan did not recruit disciples or servants for the main peak, so the grand hall appeared empty and deserted.

“As long as I don’t reveal ‘Lin Yuan’s’ identity, using the identity of the thirteenth peak’s Peak Master to do some things would have no impact.”

Lin Yuan mulled over this repeatedly, then he started to enter the arena area and select an opponent to apply for a challenge.

The arena area.

One of the arenas.

A dark-skinned man appeared.

“I didn’t expect… the formidable Peak Master of the thirteenth peak of the Red Kun Lineage, to actually choose to challenge me?”

The dark-skinned man felt somewhat flattered.

He looked at a figure appearing in the distance and said with a slightly respectful posture.

As a being who was on the cusp of stepping into the Sixth Rank with a ninety percent soul transformation,

The dark-skinned man had long stopped accepting any challenges, as his most important task was to completely focus on pushing his Soul Compatibility to Perfection.

Then he could safely step into the Sixth Rank.

The dark-skinned man was indeed doing just that.

Until—

He received a challenge application from the Peak Master of the thirteenth peak of the Red Kun Lineage.

My god.

This was the Peak Master of the thirteenth peak, a high-ranking figure in a future Star Domain.

Even if the dark-skinned man stepped into the Sixth Rank, his status would still be far inferior to that of the Peak Master of the thirteenth peak.

Therefore,

upon receiving the challenge application,

The dark-skinned man did not hesitate to choose to accept.

It was, after all, just a challenge and wouldn’t take too much time.

To witness the legendary and mysterious Peak Master of the thirteenth peak, it was worth it, regardless of winning or losing.

“Let’s begin.”

Lin Yuan looked at the dark-skinned man.

“Alright.”

After the dark-skinned man spoke,

His figure disappeared from the spot.

“Peak Master of the thirteenth peak, the Evolution Path I cultivate is known as the Shadow Evolution Path, which allows me to hide in any…”

The dark-skinned man hadn’t finished speaking,

when Lin Yuan took a step forward, moved to a spot under the shade of a tree, and reached out a hand.

A nearly invisible shadow was caught.

Then the shadow quickly solidified and took the form of the dark-skinned man.

“How… how is this possible?”

The dark-skinned man’s eyes widened in disbelief.

His method of hiding was extremely secretive, and even Sixth Rank Evolvers might overlook it if they were not paying attention. The dark-skinned man had evaded countless death traps with his hiding techniques.

But in front of the Peak Master of the thirteenth peak, it was seen through at a glance.

“Not bad.”

Lin Yuan commented.

Then he crushed the dark-skinned man’s neck.

[Your Understanding is Against Heaven, watching the ‘Shadow’ hiding method, your comprehension of the shadow laws deepens…]

…

[Your Understanding is Against Heaven, watching the ‘Shadow’ hiding method, your comprehension of the shadow laws deepens…]

…

[Your Understanding is Against Heaven, watching the ‘Shadow’ hiding method, your comprehension of the shadow laws deepens…]

…

Lin Yuan closed his eyes slightly, and under his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, the numerous techniques of the dark-skinned man were transformed into gains, integrating into the Martial Arts Evolution System.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan faintly felt that the transformation speed of his Soul Compatibility had increased ever so slightly.

Although it was not significant, it was better than usual Enlightenment by that bit.

This was not to say that Enlightenment was inefficient, but occasionally changing the style of cultivation could lead to unexpected results.

And under Against-Heaven’s Understanding, whether Lin Yuan sat down to ponder or fought to learn, both were considered a form of Enlightenment.

…

Next,

Lin Yuan continuously challenged one Evolver after another.

These Evolvers were not only limited to the Chikun Star Domain or other nearby Star Domains, but also included all the renowned Fifth Rank ultimate Evolvers within the entire Human Civilization Territory.

Some Evolvers had a terrifying fleshly body, merely relying on their robust Qi and Blood to form a huge domain. Lin Yuan also had to rely on his own explosion of power to briefly hold back the Qi and Blood Domain and then finish the opponent with a single finger.

There were also Evolvers who were masters of speed, appearing anywhere in the arena at a moment’s thought, able to attack from any corner. The faster they moved, the stronger the attack. Lin Yuan really exerted some effort before he managed to stomp his opponent to death.

As Lin Yuan battled and exchanged blows with different Evolvers, he learned more and more. In just half a month’s time, he gained what would amount to two months of meditative cultivation.

And as Lin Yuan kept on challenging,

More and more Evolvers, especially those from the Chikun Star Domain, began to take notice of Lin Yuan.
